title: Reset pagination when the query changes
contract: Implement updateQuery(state, change) for state {filters:{search,status,loanType,riskRating},pagination:{page,limit}}. change may contain any filter fields and/or a positive integer limit. Merge supplied filter fields and limit. Reset page to 1 only when a supplied query value actually changes; preserve page on a no-op. Preserve all unspecified fields. Inputs are frozen.
hints: Pagination belongs to the current query. A different filter creates a new query.
Compare previous values before resetting, and handle page-size changes too.

tests.name: Narrowing status resets page six to page one
tests.explanation: A narrow result set may not have six pages.

tests.name: A new search preserves other filters and resets page
tests.explanation: Reset pagination when search criteria change.

tests.name: Changing page size resets pagination
tests.explanation: Page size changes the interpretation of a page index.

tests.name: Identical filters preserve the active page
tests.explanation: A repeated action with identical values must not move the user.

tests.name: Multiple changes preserve all updated values
tests.explanation: Merge the query changes rather than replacing unrelated filters.

businessContext: A user navigates to Page 6 of loan applications. They then apply a filter for `status === "REJECTED"`, which only has 2 matching records. The table displays "No records found" because it requested Page 6 of a 1-page result set.
productionSymptom: The UI claims there are 0 applications found, even though the total count indicator shows "Total: 2 Applications". Users think search/filtering is broken.
